purpose: R04-T10 static character identity reference set
authority_boundary: Presentation only. Simulation-backed character identity and state remain authoritative.
design_rules: Full-body and world-icon forms must remain recognizably the same character identity.
Variation may reflect authoritative rank/progression, profession/duty, culture/status, equipment and environment/context only when provided by authoritative state.
Use original mature medieval-fantasy proportions and restrained old-school PC RPG readability; do not imitate a specific protected artist, series, character, costume, composition or signature style.
Static PNG is sufficient for this stage; animation is not a prerequisite.
World icons prioritize silhouette and role readability at small sizes; full-body forms preserve clothing/material cues suitable for later dialogue reuse.
Missing approved art must use an explicit safe fallback rather than inventing authoritative character facts.

responsive_reference.note: Native reference dimensions are design/test fixtures, not a permanent rendering mandate. Implementations may scale presentation while preserving aspect ratio, readability and device performance.

reference_note: These are deliberately simple production-reference silhouettes for mapping, scale, identity continuity and regression; they are not final art.
